name: Netravati

source.name: Bangrabalige Valley, Yelaneeru Ghat, Kudremukha Range

sink.name: Near Mangalore
sink.location: Dakshina Kannada district, Karnataka, Arabian Sea

did_you_know: The Netravati passes through Dharmasthala, one of Karnataka's most visited pilgrimage towns, and is considered one of India's holy rivers.
It rises within Kudremukh, a UNESCO-recognised biodiversity hotspot in the Western Ghats, and is the main water source for Mangalore and Bantwal.
In the early 20th century the river was known locally as the Bantwal River, after the riverside town of the same name.
